objective: 在测量前冻结L1/L2/L3 placement定义，以SGLang生产通信原语实测TP/PP多拓扑连续曲线，建立物理曲线库，并用Phase34冻结H0+DNN residual直方图验证communication-only placement排序与regret
execution_model: one workflow with external topology inventory, 24 auditable distributed GPU measurement shards, then deterministic CPU aggregation and placement validation
scheduler_decision_scope: placement/topology only; never choose TP or PP size

topology_definitions.L1: single node; every participating rank is on the same host
topology_definitions.L2: exactly two distinct hosts in the same rack; ranks are evenly split across hosts
topology_definitions.L3: exactly two distinct hosts in different racks; ranks are evenly split across hosts

topology_classification_policy: host/rack/fabric identity and placement membership must be frozen before the first benchmark record; labels may not be inferred from measured latency or bandwidth

measurement_contract.payload_basis: retain all Phase37 knots, extend down to 256 B to audit Phase38 low clamps, and extend to 256 MiB for high-payload coverage
measurement_contract.pp_backend: torch.distributed.isend/irecv over NCCL device process group, matching SGLang async send_tensor_dict GPU tensor primitive
measurement_contract.pp_scope: tensor_only_sender_counted_logical_message; both directions; per-repeat curve value is the slower direction
measurement_contract.tp_backend: SGLang GroupCoordinator.all_reduce dynamic production dispatch; single-node may use CustomAllReduce, multi-node must record the actual NCCL-compatible fallback
measurement_contract.tp_scope: representative-rank logical collective input; max completion across ranks
measurement_contract.curve_replica_policy: median across repeats within each frozen placement replica, then maximum across required placement replicas; never select the faster placement
measurement_contract.interpolation: piecewise linear over log2(payload_bytes) using unsmoothed physical knots
measurement_contract.raw_storage: all per-iteration and per-rank samples remain outside Git; Git stores only compact knots, audits, hashes and metrics

claim_boundary: Phase39 is repeated engineering evidence because Phase34D targets are already open; it is not a new blind confirmation
The physical label applies only to frozen placements and the exact tensor-only communication primitives measured
Placement ranking is communication-only and excludes compute, memory feasibility, queueing, availability, metadata and overlap
TP/PP size and execution policy are predictor inputs and are never selected by the Phase39 placement evaluator
Proxy rows remain comparison-only and may not be relabeled as physical measurements
stop_and_block_if: the topology plan is not frozen before raw measurement or derives L1/L2/L3 labels from benchmark speed
any required matrix case or either required placement replica is unavailable
the environment cannot launch the exact SGLang TP all-reduce or PP NCCL P2P primitive
raw samples would be stored inside Git
pinned inputs, R38 ancestry, production communication source SHA or result manifests differ
running requires model weights, checkpoint replay, inference or training
